FER I, 2024

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

ORDINANCE

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all of the B1-1, Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 10-E in the area bounded by

West 45th Street; South Michigan Avenue; a line 78.54 feet south of and
parallel to West 45" Street; and a line 170.80 feet west of and parallel to
South Michigan Ave.

to those of a RM-5, Residential Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Common Address of Property: 4500 S. Michigan Ave, Chicago, IL 60653
